claims.text: Friedman's 'Top Secret/MAJIC' was published by Marlowe & Co. in 1996, ISBN 1569248303, and is available as a full scan. The board's claim about his Hillenkoetter-memo analysis cited this book by title with no locator.

title: Stanton T. Friedman, 'Top Secret/MAJIC' (New York: Marlowe & Co., 1996), ISBN 1569248303
